findings.title: Run totals omit earlier loop iterations
findings.description: The report reads only persisted `action_results`. Loop executors retain earlier iterations in `StepResult.prior_rounds`, but `StateManager._append_step` does not serialize them, and `RunStateRecorder.round_completed` records nothing. A three-call probe persisted only one action. Preserve earlier iterations’ usage and test totals across multiple rounds.

findings.title: Split reviews retain only the first part’s usage
findings.description: Each part receives a usage record, but `fold_review_parts` copies the first part’s metadata without summing usage. Two $1 parts consequently report $1 rather than $2. Their pipeline artifacts are also excluded from standalone review statistics, so the missing spend appears nowhere. Aggregate every part’s usage before returning the folded result.

findings.title: Failed split-review parts violate the folding contract
findings.description: The new failure return produces an `ActionResult` with empty outputs. For multipart reviews, execution continues into `fold_review_parts`, which requires each part to identify its input file. A probe raised `TypeError: review part must name exactly one input file, got []`. The outer handler then replaces the accumulated results, losing their usage and obscuring the provider failure. Preserve part identity and explicitly handle failed parts during folding.

findings.title: Fan-out usage is discarded before persistence
findings.description: Passing the capture into branches records usage temporarily, but the fan-in reducers discard action metadata. The successful executor result retains only the reduced action; failed branches return an empty action list. A `CollectReducer` probe confirmed empty metadata despite populated branch usage. Preserve all branch usage independently of the selected output and test both successful and failed fan-outs.

findings.title: Failed compaction drops available telemetry
findings.description: Usage is stamped only after successful compaction. A `ProviderError` carrying completed-turn telemetry is caught and returned without metadata; a probe confirmed that reported spend disappears. Capture exception telemetry before returning failure, and preserve completed summary usage if subsequent session rotation fails.
